;Disasters and accidents
*A winter storm hits the [[Northeastern United States]], bringing snow to the region, affecting travel, and killing thirteen people. [http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2014/01/02/22138792-killer-storm-11-deaths-blamed-on-winter-blast-as-snow-piles-up?lite (NBC News)]
*A deep area of low pressure named [[Cyclone Anne (2014)|Anne]] brings strong winds, high tides and coastal flooding to parts of Western England, Wales, Scotland, France and Ireland. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-25584221 (BBC News)]
